030package dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting;
031
032import java.lang.System.Logger;
033import java.lang.reflect.Constructor;
034import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
035import java.text.Format;
036import java.text.ParseException;
037
038import javax.swing.JFormattedTextField;
039import javax.swing.JFormattedTextField.AbstractFormatter;
040import javax.swing.text.InternationalFormatter;
041
042import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
043
044import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
045import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.*;
046
047/**
048 * General NullAware formatter factory for SS.
049 * During build, if no defaultFromatter, try to create one from displayFormatter;
050 * just in case.
051 * <p>
052 * MaskFormatter doesn't use this.
053 */
054@SuppressWarnings("serial")
055public class SsFormatterFactory extends FormatterFactory {
056  /** Logger for component */
057  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
058
059  /**
060   *
061   * @param builder
062   */
063  protected SsFormatterFactory(Builder<?> builder) {
064    super(builder);
065
066    createDefaultFormatterIfNeeded(builder);
067
068    setDefaultFormatter(builder.defaultFormatter);
069    setDisplayFormatter(builder.displayFormatter);
070    setEditFormatter(builder.editFormatter);
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Use this factory's EditorFormatter to convert stringValue to value.
075   * {@inheritDoc }
076   */
077  @Override
078  public void switchToNonNullValue(JFormattedTextField ftf, String stringValue)
079      throws ParseException {
080    if (!(getEditFormatter() instanceof FormatterAssist fa)) {
081      logger.log(WARNING, "Unexpected type of edit formatter");
082      return;
083    }
084    ftf.setValue(fa.stringToValue(stringValue));
085    if (logger.isLoggable(TRACE)) {
086      Object v = ftf.getValue();
087      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("switch: '%s' to %s %s", stringValue,
088                                 v != null ? v.getClass().getSimpleName() : null, v));
089    }
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * SsFormatterFactory builder.
094   * @param <T>
095   */
096  public static class Builder<T extends Builder<T>> extends FormatterFactory.Builder<T> {
097    private AbstractFormatter defaultFormatter;
098    private AbstractFormatter displayFormatter;
099    private AbstractFormatter editFormatter;
100
101    /**
102     * Create the builder.
103     */
104    public Builder() {}
105
106    /**
107     * formatter
108     * @param val
109     * @return  builder
110     */
111    public T defaultFormatter(AbstractFormatter val) {
112      defaultFormatter = val;
113      return self();
114    }
115    /**
116     * formatter
117     * @param val
118     * @return  builder
119     */
120    public T displayFormatter(AbstractFormatter val) {
121      displayFormatter = val;
122      return self();
123    }
124    /**
125     * formatter
126     * @param val
127     * @return  builder
128     */
129    public T editFormatter(AbstractFormatter val) {
130      editFormatter = val;
131      return self();
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * create the factory
136     * @return the factory
137     */
138    public SsFormatterFactory build() {
139      return new SsFormatterFactory(this);
140    }
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * During build, if the default formatter is not specified and the display
145   * formatter is a subclass of International formatter then a default
146   * formatter is created with the display formatter's class and format.
147   * <p>
148   * This modifies the builder.
149   */
150  private static void createDefaultFormatterIfNeeded(Builder<?> builder) {
151    if (builder.defaultFormatter == null
152        && builder.displayFormatter instanceof InternationalFormatter ifm) {
153      Format dispFormat = ifm.getFormat();
154      try {
155        Constructor<?>[] ctors = builder.displayFormatter.getClass().getDeclaredConstructors();
156        for (Constructor<?> ctor : ctors) {
157          if (ctor.getParameterCount() != 1)
158            continue;
159          if (ctor.getParameterTypes()[0].isInstance(dispFormat)) {
160            builder.defaultFormatter = (AbstractFormatter) ctor.newInstance(dispFormat);
161            logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("Creating defaultFormatter %s for %s",
162                                       builder.defaultFormatter.getClass().getSimpleName(),
163                                       dispFormat.getClass().getSimpleName()));
164            break;
165          }
166        }
167      } catch (SecurityException | InstantiationException | IllegalAccessException
168               | IllegalArgumentException | InvocationTargetException ex) {
169        logger.log(WARNING, () -> sf("Creating defaultFormatter for %s",
170                                     dispFormat.getClass().getSimpleName()),
171            ex);
172      }
173    }
174  }
175}
